# telnyx_number_orders (Data Source)

Lists number orders, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_number_order`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The 20 most recent pending orders.
data "telnyx_number_orders" "pending" {
  filter_status = "pending"
  max_items     = 20
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_created_at_gt` (String) Filter number orders later than this value.
- `filter_created_at_lt` (String) Filter number orders earlier than this value.
- `filter_customer_reference` (String) Filter number orders via the customer reference set.
- `filter_phone_numbers_count` (String) Filter number order with this amount of numbers
- `filter_requirements_met` (Boolean) Filter number orders by requirements met.
- `filter_status` (String) Filter number orders by status.
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `number_orders` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--number_orders))

<a id="nestedatt--number_orders"></a>
### Nested Schema for `number_orders`

Read-Only:

- `billing_group_id` (String) Identifies the messaging profile associated with the phone number.
- `connection_id` (String) Identifies the connection associated with this phone number.
- `created_at` (String) An ISO 8901 datetime string denoting when the number order was created.
- `customer_reference` (String) A customer reference string for customer look ups.
- `id` (String)
- `messaging_profile_id` (String) Identifies the messaging profile associated with the phone number.
- `phone_numbers` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--number_orders--phone_numbers))
- `phone_numbers_count` (Number) The count of phone numbers in the number order.
- `record_type` (String)
- `requirements_met` (Boolean) True if all requirements are met for every phone number, false otherwise.
- `status` (String) The status of the order.
- `sub_number_orders_ids` (List of String)
- `updated_at` (String) An ISO 8901 datetime string for when the number order was updated.

<a id="nestedatt--number_orders--phone_numbers"></a>
